name: Davi Claudino
bio:
Davi Claudino (October 7, 1996, Santo André, São Paulo, Brazil) is a Brazilian actor, performer, stage director, and theater teacher.

He began his artistic career at the age of eleven, attending a theater acting workshop and performing in various productions. He graduated in Theater in 2018.

Davi starred in the films “O Assassino do Boom / The Boom Killer” (Bardo Filmes, 2026), directed by Mateus Guidoni and Vitor Dividino; “A Última Oração” (Pane Filmes, 2025), directed by Saulo Carvalho and Dan Claudino; “Whey: Uma Saga Anabólica em Busca da Verdade” (SPEC Filmes, 2023), directed by Mateus Guidoni; and “Flores Secas” (Murano Produções, 2017), directed by Julia Gorgulho. He also starred in “Pule ou Ocorrência às 4h48” (Coletivo ERROR 404, 2020), a video adaptation of the homonymous stage play, filmed at home during the Covid-19 pandemic and premiered via live streaming on Facebook.

On television, Davi appeared in the third episode of the miniseries “Extremos da Cidade” (TV Gazeta, 2014), which highlighted the importance of artistic production in the outskirts of São Paulo. He has also participated in several music videos, including projects for Grupo Aspas.

His theater credits include productions such as “De Botina pra Ozébio” (dir. Davi Claudino, 2025); “À Deriva” (Coletivo ERROR 404, dir. Dan Claudino and Davi Claudino, 2019); “O Último Carro” (Skena, dir. Walmir Pavam, 2018); “O Balcão / The Balcony” (Skena, dir. Rudson Marcello, 2017); “4.48” (Coletivo ERROR 404, dir. Michelle Lomba, 2016–2017); “Adolescer Indefinido” (Usina dos Atos, dir. Priscilla Tessuto, 2016); “O Casamento de Mané Bocó” (Grama Verde, dir. André Blumenschein, 2015); the award-winning “Histórias de bobos, bocós, burraldos e paspalhões” (Grama Verde, dir. André Blumenschein, 2014–2016); “Aquela Água Toda” (dir. Cacá Carvalho, 2014); and “Mistério na Sala de Ensaio e Outras Histórias” (dir. André Blumenschein, 2013), among others. He also directed and starred in “Pule ou Ocorrência às 4h48” (Coletivo ERROR 404, dir. Dan Claudino and Davi Claudino, 2019–2021), which received critical acclaim for its staging and performance.

Davi conducts theater workshops and socio-educational programs for children and adults at Instituto Baccarelli, integrating art and education as tools for social transformation.

credits.title: Eu, a Kombi e a Garotinha que Encontrei no Meio do Caminho
credits.overview: Marcela decides to hit the road after an encounter with a fortune teller. Along the way, she meets Lia, and the journey takes on new meaning. Amid changing landscapes and encounters, they embark on a path that changes their lives.

credits.title: The Boom Killer
credits.overview: A great tragedy occurs during the filming of a movie. In an unexpected twist, the renowned Detective Bones takes on the case, as he can sniff out that something isn’t right.

credits.title: The Last Prayer
credits.overview: Caio is a deeply religious young man, living in the shadow of his brother, Alberto. While Alberto challenges norms and embraces life, Caio feels trapped by his beliefs. In a moment of desperation, Caio murders Alberto and stages his death as a suicide, convincing himself that he acted in God’s name.

credits.title: Whey: An Anabolic Saga in Search of the Truth
credits.overview: A Whey Protein was stolen inside a fraternity of boys. An investigation begins to discover the real person responsible for the theft.

credits.title: It Happened at 4:48 AM
credits.overview: Five young people. Five minds. Five private universes. An intersex person, a young man living with HIV, a university student, a young woman marked by sexual violence, and a participant in the Blue Whale game. The violent hour: 4:48 a.m., when lucidity and desolation converge. These are intense nights in which they cry

credits.title: Dry Flowers
credits.overview: After his parents’ difficult divorce, Frederico decides to move to São Paulo to live with his mother and study engineering, a childhood dream. However, Fred begins to see himself differently; his best friend starts dating the girl of his dreams, and he is forced to confront his greatest problem: himself.
